ms.report:
A. Output: Successful execution of the hackathon
Acceptance criteria: 
・A total of 94 participants joined the hackathon, which was slightly below the acceptance criteria of 100+
・While Opshin leverages the accessible syntax of Python, it represents a specialized domain within blockchain development (Smart Contracts). As Opshin is an emerging technology in its early adoption phase, the learning curve naturally filtered the audience. We attracted 94 highly committed developers—quality early adopters—rather than a broad, casual audience. This is evidenced by the high engagement in Milestone 4
